end_goal: Given a rank produced at time T, determine when the buy should actually happen — with a defensible, uncertainty-quantified answer that produces an execution change measurably better than the current baseline.
why_it_matters: The Streamlit baseline fills at the very price the rank was computed from. If most of its apparent edge is that same-bar fill (H9), the current execution is not tradable and every downstream optimisation is measuring an artefact. The first honest number is worth more than any amount of model work.
success_criteria: BASELINE_HONEST exists and its gap to BASELINE_ASIS is quantified with an uncertainty interval
H9 and H10 are resolved — confirmed or refuted — and counted toward FDR
The entry-time x rank-vintage x exit-rule grid has been run with purged/embargoed CV and overfitting controls
A specific execution change is recommended, with the expected improvement and the interval around it
Every number on the console traces to a run under the full contract-gate suite
non_negotiables: Upstream is read-only; the archive is append-only
No same-bar execution, ever — fills strictly after the information timestamp
Decisions key off available_at, never run_ts
Placeholder-stamped runs are not tradable at their timestamp
Every result ships with an uncertainty interval
Pre-register every hypothesis and count it toward FDR
If a contract test fails, stop rather than loosening the assertion

lanes.cowork: The brain. Holds the end goal, reads the state each heartbeat, decides what is next, writes the cycle. Owns dashboard/ and the review protocol.
lanes.claude-code: The build. Owns src/, scripts/, tests/, docs/, config/ and data/build/manifest.yaml. Pulls work orders, reports through review.py, raises findings.
lanes.andrew: The decisions only he can make — scope, priority, what counts as a tradable result, and anything touching real money.

autonomy: Cowork issues work orders freely when they are unambiguously next on the critical path. Anything that changes scope, spends money, or picks between defensible approaches is queued as a question or decision for Andrew.
notify: push, only for items addressed to Andrew
